deal_seq.description: Per-deal monotonic event number assigned by BF (persisted with the deal; survives restart). Present on events BF writes to the deal's event journal; a gap seen by AFB means a lost event, healed on the next session.resync (BF replays the journal tail above the `applied_deal_seq` AFB reports). On deal.snapshot it is the last number issued at snapshot time and is not itself consumed. Optional: an older BF omits it, an older AFB ignores it.

at.description: ISO-8601 BF event-occurrence time (same value as the BF journal entry `at`).

fills.description: Trade-based fill log: one element per broker trade, not per order — an order filled in several trades (e.g. Finam SubscribeTrades) yields one element per trade, all sharing the same order_id. `order_id` remains the reference to the parent order (for role/leg); `summary` and the aggregate commission fields are not part of this payload (removed in v2.0.10, see below); the per-trade exchange fee is the optional `exchange_fee`.

trade_id.description: Broker trade identifier. For brokers without a native trade concept, a synthetic id derived from order_id (e.g. `synth-{order_id}`).

exchange_fee.description: Exchange fee (Finam `AccountTrade.commission`, the BUYSELLFEE part) charged for this very trade. The broker books it after clearing, so it is absent in the closing report and arrives later in a repeated deal.report (same fills, new `deal_seq`) — consumers merge it by `trade_id`. The BROKER commission is deliberately NOT part of this payload: it depends on the tariff (per contract, % of daily turnover, side-dependent) and cannot be attributed to a single deal; it travels per account in broker.accounts `broker_fees`.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 fill time (order's last status-transition time on BF); may be null for legacy BF versions predating this field.

title: payload: deal.report
description: Report attached to deal.status_changed(closed) with the trade-based fill log for the just-closed deal. It may be sent again for the same deal as a PATCH (same fills, enriched with data the broker books later, e.g. `fills[].exchange_fee`; every send gets a new `deal_seq` and idempotency key) — a consumer merges by `trade_id` and must not treat the repeat as a second close. `trade_id` is not required — tolerant of older BF versions that predate it. The `summary` block (entry/exit_avg_price, realized_pnl, total_commission) was removed in v2.0.10: it had no consumers (AFB computes realized PnL itself from fills/order events), was never in `required`, and `additionalProperties: true` keeps old and new payloads mutually valid — a PATCH, not a breaking change. `fills[].commission` was removed in the same step for the same reason; it is replaced by the optional per-trade `fills[].exchange_fee` (a real consumer exists now: realized P&L after exchange fee) — BROKER commission is intentionally not carried per deal.
